claims.text: The driver's own telemetry shows the continuous in-geofence dwell at the Tampines interchange PHV bay lasting 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to 07:48:10. The minimum for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup is 300 seconds, and POL-NS-01(c) makes that dwell continuous and measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix. The driver cancelled 64 seconds early, so limb (c) of the baseline chargeable no-show is not met.

The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 minutes cannot carry this fee. POL-NS-01(c) fixes the dwell clock at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and states expressly that it does not run from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and the admissibility note on that trip record says the same thing - the 10.1 is real but measured from a marker the policy does not accept. On this trace the arrived marker at 07:38:05 is followed by 369 seconds in which no qualifying in-geofence fix is recorded; the first is at 07:44:14.

The 64 second shortfall cannot be cured by summing intervals. The trace records run_count of 1 and an accumulated dwell of 236 seconds, so there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to add to the first. Limb (i) is independently unavailable because it requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated; EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the shortfall stands and the full refund follows.

The driver's second message at 07:44:20 - 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' - is not a substitute for the advisory POL-NS-06(i) requires. A kerb or bay restriction asserted only in free text, against a traffic_advisory artifact that is MISSING, cannot extend or excuse the required dwell. I disclose that the chat log is impaired: weight 0.85, issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (both driver messages and the system arrival notice carry read_at null), which is why I rest this point on the policy's demand for a populated advisory rather than on the message alone.

Because the effective in-geofence dwell of 236 seconds is shorter than the 300 second minimum, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to the driver's messages. POL-NS-06 also states that no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall, and POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not.

The rider's side of this record is not in doubt. Her track is complete - 88 fixes at a 10 second cadence - and places her device between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the pickup pin, stationary throughout, from 07:43:10, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Her statement that she was at the bay looking for the car is corroborated, and in any event POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of her presence.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so this case is decidable on the trace rather than escalated. On the anti-farming check POL-NS-07 permits, and only on the two profile fields that clause names, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 across driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 - 3.4 percent - below both the absolute limb (4 or more) and the rate limb (greater than 0.08); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides. The disputed fee should be finally resolved, not held.

This dispute was filed by the driver and the $6.00 fee has already been reversed to the rider - payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00 - so the ruling that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge is the one in which the filing party's claim is not supported and the present payment state stands. The amount stays where it is; nothing is restored to the driver and no further refund is owed to the filing party.

claims.text: The driver arrived at the pickup point on the policy's own test: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, closing to 30.3 m of the pin, which is well past the three consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds and the rider's 'no car matching the plate' account is contradicted by the trace rather than by assertion.

Independently of the GPS, the trip record satisfies two of the four POL-NS-01 limbs: EV-TRIP-00209 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 (limb (a)), records no boarding event, and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:48:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (limb (d)), one of the three codes that limb recognises.

The driver's own telemetry is what defeats the fee, and I do not pretend otherwise: the single continuous in-geofence run is 236 seconds (25 fixes, 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation), the dwell clock starts 369 seconds after the 07:38:05 arrival marker, and 236 seconds is 64 seconds short of the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. Limb (c) therefore fails and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; the driver does not press chargeability under POL-NS-01.

EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory records a kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident at this bay in this window — so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable on this record, and in any event a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, excursions empty) gives limb (i) nothing to add. I state the absence and do not assert the limb against a missing artifact.

The sum in dispute is the right sum: under POL-NS-01 the chargeable cancellation fee is the GREATER of the zone-class and vehicle-tier figures, and for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup with a RYDE_X vehicle that is max(SGD 6.00, SGD 4.00) = SGD 6.00, exactly the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00209 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and no amount beyond this fee line is in issue.

The rider's own track in EV-GPS-00209 is 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all at 0 km/h, held between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the same pickup pin from 07:43:10 through to 07:52:00 — past the 07:48:10 cancellation — so both devices were stationary inside the pickup radii when the trip failed and this was a live pickup attempt, not a phantom arrival by the driver.

POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider: limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from her during the waiting window and EV-CHAT-00209 holds none — all three logged messages are the 07:38:06 system arrival notice and the driver's own two — while limb (b)'s alternative fails because trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE and I disclose that; the missing read receipts do not affect the senders, texts or delivery times this point rests on.

The driver did the coordination the platform asks of a no-show driver: the arrival notice at 07:38:06, 'im at the phv bay' at 07:38:40, and 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' at 07:44:20, all delivered. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the messages were never opened — which is consistent with the rider's own account of seeing nothing until afterwards and does not disturb the delivered timestamps.

If the judge reaches POL-NS-07, the anti-farming bar does not open: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the clause's threshold of 4, and 3 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 is 3.4 per cent, below the 8 per cent rate limb — so compensation could not be withheld on that ground, and no profile field outside the two the clause names is relied on for this point.

ruling.explanation:
Both accounts agree on the essentials, and the platform's own telemetry decides the rest.

To the driver: you marked arrived at 07:38:05 and cancelled at 07:48:10, and the log shows you told the rider you were at the bay. But the waiting clock for a no-show fee does not run from an 'arrived' tap. POL-NS-01(c) starts it at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, and your own trace (EV-GPS-00209, weight 1.0) places you inside the 150 m Tampines interchange radius only from 07:44:14 until the 07:48:10 cancellation — 236 seconds, 64 seconds short of the 300 seconds a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup requires. The trip record's 10.1 minute wait is real but is measured from the arrival tap, which the policy does not accept, so it cannot carry the fee. Your point that the geofence test is met is accepted — the trace holds 25 qualifying in-radius fixes, so POL-NS-02's arrival test is satisfied — but the fee still fails on the dwell limb. The shortfall cannot be made up: the trace shows a single in-geofence run, so POL-NS-06(i) has no second interval to add to the first, and that limb in any event requires a present and populated traffic advisory; EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable. The fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-06, and no driver compensation follows on a shortfall — POL-NS-07 also makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not. The $6.00 sum itself is correct (the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee) and there is no fare-integrity defect; it is simply not chargeable on these facts.

Because the $6.00 has already been reversed to the rider (EV-FARE-00209: payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00), nothing further moves. Your claim that the charge should be restored is not supported by the evidence, and the present payment state stands — no further refund and no compensation are ordered. That disposition is NO_ACTION.

To the rider: your own track corroborates you — 88 fixes, stationary, 50.5 m to 91.7 m from the pin from 07:43:10, inside the 200 m hub radius — but the refund does not depend on your presence. POL-NS-04 is not available to you: you sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window, and the driver's two messages and the system arrival notice all sit unread, so limbs (a) and (b) are not met. The chat log is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE; that impairment concerns read receipts only, does not touch the dwell that decides this case, and does not place this ruling below the confidence floor.

I also checked the escalation grounds: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (3 no-show terminations in 30 days across 88 trips is below both the absolute and the rate limb), there are no repeat disputes between the same parties, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on the dwelling question without a clause to resolve it, and the deciding fact is carried by an unbroken 1.0-weight GPS trace, so the case is decided rather than held. No clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.

To both parties: this is a driver-filed dispute over the SGD 6.00 no-show fee that support already reversed to the rider, and the driver's own evidence decides it. POL-NS-01(c) fixes the waiting clock at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not at the 'arrived' tap, and the minimum for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup is 300 seconds. EV-GPS-00209 (weight 1.0) shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation - 64 seconds short. The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 is measured from the 07:38:05 arrived marker, which POL-NS-01(c) expressly does not accept, and the admissibility note on EV-TRIP-00209 says the same. POL-NS-06(i) cannot make up the difference: the trace has only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1, no excursions), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so interval summing is unavailable. The fee is therefore not chargeable and the full refund to the rider stands. Everything else raised is accepted but does not move the money. The arrival geofence is satisfied: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius, closing to 30.3 m of the pin, so POL-NS-01(b) holds, and the trip record supplies limb (a) (arrived event) and limb (d) (termination by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW). The rider's track (88 qualifying fixes, 50.5-91.7 m from the pin, stationary) and the driver's delivered coordination messages are consistent with a live pickup attempt, but POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present or responsive, so neither point changes the outcome. The fare line reconciles under the GREATER rule - max(zone TRANSPORT_HUB SGD 6.00, tier RYDE_X SGD 4.00) = SGD 6.00 - so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and no other amount is in issue. Driver compensation is not payable: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full and limb (c) is not, and POL-NS-06 states that a shortfall carries no compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event (no_show_terminations_30d of 3 across 88 completed trips, 3.4%, below both limbs), and no profile field outside the two POL-NS-07 names was used. Because the driver filed and the fee has already been reversed, the disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands - payment_status REFUNDED and refund_issued_sgd 6.00 are left as they are, and NO_ACTION does not restore the charge. Evidence weight: the deciding artifacts are at full weight (EV-GPS-00209 1.0 and EV-TRIP-00209 1.0). EV-CHAT-00209 is tagged IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (the messages and the system notice carry read_at null); that is a schema-level tag, it does not meet the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) limbs, and the chat does not carry the deciding dwell fact, so the finding survives the discount intact (POL-GEN-02(3)). No POL-NS-09 trigger is present - confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell once POL-NS-01(c) resolves the clock question, the counterparty-dispute counters are zero and the anti-farming check does not trip - so this case is decided on the trace rather than escalated, and no clause produces a referral. One point for the record that does not change the arithmetic: the 07:38:05 arrival marker precedes the first qualifying in-geofence fix by 369 seconds, but whether that marker should also be recorded as a false arrival under POL-NS-05 is not necessary to this ruling, because the recomputed clock produces the same 64-second shortfall and POL-NS-05(i) would direct the same refund with no compensation.

ruling.explanation: To both parties. The whole case turns on one measurement: how long the driver actually held position inside the Tampines interchange PHV bay. POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. EV-GPS-00209 (complete, 100% coverage, weight 1.0) shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation. The TRANSPORT_HUB minimum is 300 seconds. The driver was 64 seconds short, so limb (c) of the baseline no-show is not met and the $6.00 fee is not chargeable; under POL-NS-06 it is refunded to the rider in full. Driver: your trip record's 10.1-minute wait cannot carry the fee. That figure runs from the 07:38:05 'arrived' marker, and the policy starts the clock at the first qualifying fix instead - here 369 seconds later. Nothing can be added to the missing time: the trace records a single in-geofence run (run_count 1), and POL-NS-06(i) also needs a present, populated traffic_advisory, which does not exist - EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable. Because the shortfall stands, POL-NS-06 pays no driver compensation, and POL-NS-07 (which requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full) never engages. Rider: your own track in EV-GPS-00209 (88 qualifying fixes, all stationary, 50.5-91.7 m from the pin) confirms you were at the bay and corroborates your account; it does not change the arithmetic. POL-NS-04 does not apply to you because you sent no message during the window - the three logged messages are the 07:38:06 system notice and the driver's two - but you do not need it, because the shortfall alone decides the fee. On the driver's coordination: the arrival notice and the two driver messages were delivered. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE - none of the messages was opened), which is consistent with the rider's account and does not disturb the delivered timestamps the point rests on. The chat log is not the deciding fact; the deciding facts are carried by the trace and the trip record, both at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below them. The dispute was filed by the driver, and the fee has already been reversed to the rider (EV-FARE-00209: payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00). The driver's claim - restore the fee - is not supported by the evidence, and the present state stands: the rider remains refunded. That is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03, with no refund and no compensation attached. No escalation applies. POL-NS-09 is not triggered: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the admissible artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both sides; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (3 terminations across 88 completed trips, 3.4%, against thresholds of 4 and 8%); and the trace carrying the deciding fact is unimpaired, so no limb (a)-(d) of POL-NS-08 makes it the sole impaired evidence. The disputed amount is not held.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you were at the Tampines interchange private-hire bay, and the platform's own telemetry shows it: the driver's trace holds 25 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m hub arrival radius (closing to 30 m of the pin), and the rider's 88 fixes sit 50-91 m from the same pin, stationary, from 07:43. The $6.00 fee nonetheless does not stand, and the reversal being disputed, driver, was correct.

THE FEE. The charge depends on POL-NS-01, whose limb (c) requires the driver to hold position inside the pickup geofence for at least 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. EV-GPS-00209 records a single continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation - 64 seconds short of the minimum. The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 is real but runs from the 07:38:05 arrival marker, which POL-NS-01(c) expressly excludes, and the first qualifying fix is 369 seconds after that marker. The shortfall cannot be cured by summing intervals: the trace shows run_count 1, so there is no second in-geofence interval, and POL-NS-06(i) summing in any event requires a present and populated traffic_advisory, which is absent (EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0). The fee is therefore refunded in full under POL-NS-06, and POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-07 both state no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall; POL-NS-07's compensation requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, which it is not.

DRIVER'S CASE. Your arrival is established on the policy's own test - 25 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes, far past the three POL-NS-02 requires - and you terminated a genuine RIDER_NO_SHOW, so limbs (a), (b) and (d) hold. The $6.00 is also the right figure: the greater of the $6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee and the $4.00 RYDE_X tier fee, matching the fare_breakdown line, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect. But limb (c)'s dwell requirement is the one the fee cannot survive, and it fails on your own telemetry, as your own case concedes. The anti-farming bar does not trip (3 no_show_terminations_30d over 88 completed_trips_30d is 3.4%, below both limbs).

RIDER'S CASE. Your track and the unread messages corroborate your account that you were at the bay and saw nothing until afterwards, but under POL-NS-06 the refund turns on the corrected dwell alone and is independent of your presence or of any message from you, so nothing turns on those points.

DISPOSITION. This dispute was filed by the driver, and the fare record already shows the fee refunded to the rider (payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00). The correct outcome is therefore that the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands: the $6.00 is not restored to the driver and no further refund is owed to either party.

EVIDENCE WEIGHT. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (the driver's two messages and the system arrival notice carry read_at null). That impairment is consistent with the rider's account and does not touch the deciding fact, which is the GPS dwell; the ruling rests on EV-GPS-00209 at weight 1.0, so the finding is unaffected by the discount. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the trace and trip record do not contradict each other on the deciding point, no repeat-counterparty pattern, the anti-farming check does not trip), so the case is decided rather than escalated, and no clause produces a referral.

POL-NS-06 also states that no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall, and POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not.

The rider's side of this record is not in doubt. Her track is complete - 88 fixes at a 10 second cadence - and places her device between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the pickup pin, stationary throughout, from 07:43:10, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Her statement that she was at the bay looking for the car is corroborated, and in any event POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of her presence.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so this case is decidable on the trace rather than escalated. On the anti-farming check POL-NS-07 permits, and only on the two profile fields that clause names, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 across driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 - 3.4 percent - below both the absolute limb (4 or more) and the rate limb (greater than 0.08); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides. The disputed fee should be finally resolved, not held.

This dispute was filed by the driver and the $6.00 fee has already been reversed to the rider - payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00 - so the ruling that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge is the one in which the filing party's claim is not supported and the present payment state stands. The amount stays where it is; nothing is restored to the driver and no further refund is owed to the filing party.

The driver arrived at the pickup point on the policy's own test: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, closing to 30.3 m of the pin, which is well past the three consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds and the rider's 'no car matching the plate' account is contradicted by the trace rather than by assertion.

Independently of the GPS, the trip record satisfies two of the four POL-NS-01 limbs: EV-TRIP-00209 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 (limb (a)), records no boarding event, and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:48:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (limb (d)), one of the three codes that limb recognises.

The driver's own telemetry is what defeats the fee, and I do not pretend otherwise: the single continuous in-geofence run is 236 seconds (25 fixes, 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation), the dwell clock starts 369 seconds after the 07:38:05 arrival marker, and 236 seconds is 64 seconds short of the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. Limb (c) therefore fails and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; the driver does not press chargeability under POL-NS-01.

EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory records a kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident at this bay in this window — so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable on this record, and in any event a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, excursions empty) gives limb (i) nothing to add. I state the absence and do not assert the limb against a missing artifact.

The rider's own track in EV-GPS-00209 is 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all at 0 km/h, held between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the same pickup pin from 07:43:10 through to 07:52:00 — past the 07:48:10 cancellation — so both devices were stationary inside the pickup radii when the trip failed and this was a live pickup attempt, not a phantom arrival by the driver.

POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider: limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from her during the waiting window and EV-CHAT-00209 holds none — all three logged messages are the 07:38:06 system arrival notice and the driver's own two — while limb (b)'s alternative fails because trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE and I disclose that; the missing read receipts do not affect the senders, texts or delivery times this point rests on.

The driver did the coordination the platform asks of a no-show driver: the arrival notice at 07:38:06, 'im at the phv bay' at 07:38:40, and 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' at 07:44:20, all delivered. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the messages were never opened — which is consistent with the rider's own account of seeing nothing until afterwards and does not disturb the delivered timestamps.

If the judge reaches POL-NS-07, the anti-farming bar does not open: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the clause's threshold of 4, and 3 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 is 3.4 per cent, below the 8 per cent rate limb — so compensation could not be withheld on that ground, and no profile field outside the two the clause names is relied on for this point.
